method: headless Chrome (software rendering, Windows, 8 vCPU) driven over the DevTools protocol; the host measures its own per-frame work (header, wasm call, draw) with performance.now(); 12 s of scripted pointer motion plus wheel scrolling; the sentinel wasm built by the TS reference emitter (equal to the A0 emitter output)
note: headless animation frames ran at about 120 per second; the numbers are host cost per frame in ms, not frame rate; no load average exists on Windows, so no timing claim is published from this file
